description: This file defines the HierarchicalKeyStore class, which implements a hierarchical key-value data store with methods for reading, writing, deleting, and dumping data. It manages data with multiple key layers and handles concurrency with locking.

classes.name: HierarchicalKeyStore
classes.description: An internal class implementing a hierarchical key-value data store with support for multiple key layers, data retrieval, modification, deletion, and data dumping.

methods.name: WriteRow
methods.description: Stores data associated with a list of hierarchical keys, updating the ETag.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a list of hierarchical keys.

methods.name: ReadMultiRow
methods.description: Retrieves multiple data entries matching the provided hierarchical keys.

methods.name: DeleteRow
methods.description: Deletes a data entry associated with the specified hierarchical keys.

methods.name: DumpData
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all stored data, optionally printing a dump.

methods.name: MakeStoreKey
methods.description: Creates a string key from a collection of key pairs for storage and retrieval.

methods.name: NewEtag
methods.description: Generates a new ETag value, incrementing the counter.
